summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 8, 2026, disclosing that Brazil's INEMA granted the environmental permit for the GAN open pit and associated infrastructure at the Maracás Menchen vanadium mine in Bahia. GAN is the second open pit in the mining sequence, adjacent to Campbell, and contains copper, gold and PGM by-products; the 31-year life-of-mine plan already incorporates the deposit. No transaction, price, stake or board recommendation is involved; this is an operational permitting milestone ahead of eventual development capex decisions.
